@graph.description: This artifact reproduces the core findings of the USENIX FAST '26 paper 'Here, There and Everywhere: The Past, the Present and the Future of Local Storage in Cloud' by Alibaba Group and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. It evaluates NVMe storage performance across queue depths, hybrid local-cloud tiering (LATTE) with S3-FIFO caching and Linear-SVM dispatching, and introduces Q-LATTE to resolve multi-tenant QoS interference.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: End-to-end reproducible experiment evaluating cloud local storage evolution, LATTE hybrid tiering, and multi-tenant QoS.
@graph.name: Reproducing Cloud Local Storage Evolution & LATTE Hybrid Tiering (USENIX FAST '26)
